crossCuttingInvariants.contract: Canonical protection always overrides normal control in every assistance/authority combination.
Requested and effective plant control authority remain separately visible and semantically distinct.
Supervisory degradation is fail-closed, evidence-based and cannot silently retain automatic authority.
Expected command influence remains separate from observed response evidence.
External grid demand remains separate from requested generator load and actual electrical output.
Challenge scoring remains observational and never acquires plant-command authority.
Unavailable or suspect measurements remain unavailable or suspect; no true-state substitution is permitted.
MISSION remains presentation-only and never dispatches plant commands.
Replay/checkpoint reconstruction must reproduce equivalent operator-visible canonical state without opaque workstation dumps.
crossCuttingInvariants.owner: M9.1 recorder + M10.7 session + M10.9.7 projection
